option_relations.rationale: PARP inhibitor-induced interstitial lung disease (ILD) is a specific type of drug-induced ILD, which is a broader category. There are no specific leaves for PARP inhibitor-induced ILD.
Drug-induced interstitial lung disease (pneumonitis) is a broad category that encompasses various forms of lung injury caused by medications. There are no specific leaves for drug-induced ILD.

Drug-induced pneumonitis is a general term for inflammation of the lungs caused by drugs. It is a broader category than specific types of drug-induced lung disease. There are no specific leaves for drug-induced pneumonitis.

Hypersensitivity pneumonitis is an immune-mediated lung disease caused by exposure to inhaled antigens, distinct from drug-induced lung injury. The provided leaf is Eosinophilic pneumonia, which is not directly related to hypersensitivity pneumonitis.
